text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After finally getting permission to run in Japan...
To end up with a result like this is just pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was being naive.
No matter how fun running is, that alone isn't enough...
choice_data_list: Your ability to enjoy yourself is one of your greatest strengths.
Your ability to have fun is one of your greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was being naive.
No matter how fun running is, that alone isn't enough...
choice_data_list: Your ability to enjoy yourself is one of your greatest strengths.
Your ability to have fun is one of your greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Besides, there was both effort and passion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I see, I shouldn't forget that there were plenty of good things too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: On top of that, we have to identify the cause of the defeat and properly reflect on it, or we won't be able to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's win next time... No, I WILL win...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that I can show everyone a wonderful smile.
And to enjoy racing even more, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Harsh words are precisely what I need right now...
choice_data_list: However, you don't have to carry it all alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that as her trainer, I share the blame
for this defeat, because I failed to bring out
her true strength...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be discouraged...!
I want to live up to your feelings, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I won't lose again...!
Let us aim for greater heights together!
